name: scraper
description: Pak-Tel Digital Data eSIM Store & Self-Service ICCID Top-Up Platform on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build:local: npm run build && mkdir -p .data && ./web/node_modules/.bin/esbuild worker/src/local-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:node:sqlite --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=.data/local-server.mjs
scripts.test:worker: mkdir -p .data && ./web/node_modules/.bin/esbuild worker/src/router.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:node:sqlite --external:node:test --external:node:assert/strict --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=.data/router.test.mjs && node --test .data/router.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test -- --run && npm run test:worker
